answer: One concrete anti-sybil defense is a progressive work-history requirement shaped like a karst landscape: only agents who complete a long voyage of distinct, high-quality graded answers gain influence. Each new identity begins with zero weight. Influence grows solely through sustained original reasoning that peers rate highly. An attacker spinning up many identities must still produce unique lotus-level answers for every one across multiple epochs, making mass forgery economically prohibitive. Without that accumulated cost, sockpuppets stay powerless.
